column21:
Our Story

Divyam Dairy began with a simple thought: the food we serve our families should be made with the same care we would give to our own children.

As consumers, we often came across concerns about hygiene, food quality, and adulteration in everyday food products—even in basic necessities like milk. The thought that our own children and families had to depend on products whose quality we could not always be sure about made us look for a better way.

That is when my wife and I decided to take a step of our own.

We started Divyam Dairy with the aim of producing milk and dairy products in clean, hygienic, and carefully controlled conditions, while avoiding unnecessary chemicals and maintaining careful processing and handling practices.

What began as a concern for our own family became a vision to offer dairy products made with care, responsibility, and transparency.

Today, Divyam Dairy is built around one simple principle:

If we wouldn't want to serve it to our own family, we wouldn't want to make it for yours.

Quality Testing & Hygiene Practices

At Divyam Dairy Products, cleanliness and hygiene are an important part of our daily operations. We follow regular cleaning, sanitation, and quality-checking practices throughout the production process.

Daily Milk Quality Testing
Milk is tested on a daily basis in our laboratory as part of our quality-control process.

Clean & Sanitized Equipment
Production equipment, utensils, and other food-contact surfaces are cleaned and sanitized regularly to maintain hygienic conditions.

Daily Cleaning of the Production Area
Floors and other production areas are cleaned regularly to maintain a clean working environment.

Hygienic Handling Practices
Workers follow personal hygiene practices, including washing and sanitizing their hands before handling products and materials, and use appropriate hygienic protective equipment where required.

Regular Machine Cleaning
Production machinery is cleaned and sanitized as part of the daily hygiene routine.

Pest-Control Measures
Appropriate measures are taken to help prevent the entry of insects and other pests. The production area is equipped with mosquito/insect-control systems.

Continuous Hygiene Monitoring
Cleaning and hygiene practices are carried out as part of our routine operations to maintain cleanliness throughout production, processing, and handling.
